languages.reason: ACS 2023 5yr Dona Ana County: Hispanic 68%, Spanish at home 27.8%; border county

cultural_notes: the Hatch green chile roast is a late-summer civic ritual across southern New Mexico: roaster drums turn outside grocers Aug-Sep and 'red or green?' is the official state question of New Mexico (source: New Mexico statute, state question adopted 1996; newmexico.org green chile culture)
Hatch, NM (45 min north) bills itself the 'Green Chile Capital of the World' and holds the Hatch Chile Festival over Labor Day weekend (source: hatchchilefest.com; newmexico.org)

NMSU (New Mexico State University) college-town rhythm shapes the market; Dia de los Muertos and border-Tejano food culture are present (INFERRED cultural framing from region knowledge -- verify tone before production use)
conservation note: Organ Mountains are Chihuahuan desert, not bear habitat -- keep any bear/grizzly angle national and conservation-toned, not local-habitat
